verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a harness-agnostic pack of markdown skills and a bootstrap injector that runs inside host coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Connecting MCP servers and calling their tools is the job of those host harnesses, not of a skills library, so this story's axis does not fit the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Superpowers itself acting as an MCP client.
